items.headline: Connecting with Brown in practice
items.description: Maye was sharp at Friday's practice, which he started off with a long touchdown pass to A.J. Brown on the first play of the 11-on-11 period, Paul Perillo of the Patriots' official site reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.headline: Building connection with Maye
items.description: After the connection between Brown and QB Drake Maye got off to a slow start in training camp, Paul Perillo of the Patriots' official site notes that "there have been some serious signs of life since the pads came on Thursday morning." Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.headline: Knee injury being evaluated
items.description: San Francisco assistant head coach Chris Foerster said Friday that the team is "continuing to evaluate" Pearsall (knee) after the wide receiver aggravated the PCL issue in his right knee during early training camp practices, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.headline: Easing back in
items.description: Rice (knee) is being eased back into the mix during training camp, Jesse Newell of The Athletic reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.headline: Full return TBD
items.description: Tagovailoa (back) did not take part in team drills Friday due to a "precautionary thing" related to back tightness and said he is unsure when he will be fully cleared for on-field activities, Marc Raimondi of ESPN reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.headline: Praised by RB coach
items.description: Browns running backs coach Duce Staley said Friday that the "sky's the limit" for Judkins, Scott Petrak of the Elyria Chronicle-Telegram reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.headline: Brought off PUP list
items.description: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Friday that Kraft (ACL) is being brought off the active/PUP list and will practice in some capacity, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.headline: Unavailable Friday
items.description: Monangai was absent from Friday's practice due to an undisclosed reason, Patrick Finley of the Chicago Sun-Times reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.headline: Splitting first-team reps
items.description: Dowdle and Jaylen Warren split first-team running back reps across the Steelers' first two training camp practices, Daniel Chavkin of SportsNet Pittsburgh reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.headline: First-team split begins
items.description: Warren and Rico Dowdle split first-team running back reps across the Steelers' first two training camp practices, Daniel Chavkin of SportsNet Pittsburgh reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.headline: First up for first-team reps
items.description: Price got the opening first-team backfield reps during Seattle's first full-team scrimmage Thursday, Gregg Bell of The News Tribune reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.headline: Logs first practice since ACL tear
items.description: Kraft (knee), who was activated from the active/PUP list Friday, took part in individual drills at his first practice of Packers training camp, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.headline: Handles team drills during ramp-up
items.description: Olave took part in the first session of 11-on-11 team drills during Friday's training camp practice, Ross Jackson of LouisianaSports.net reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.headline: Feeling 'great' at practice
items.description: Nabers (knee) said Thursday that he "felt great" after practicing Wednesday for the first time since having his torn ACL surgically repaired in October, Matt Citak of the Giants' official site reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.headline: Clicks with Maye on Thursday
items.description: During Thursday's padded practice, Brown and QB Drake Maye routinely connected throughout the session, Mark Daniels of MassLive.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.headline: Back in San Francisco
items.description: Samuel and the 49ers agreed on a one-year, $7 million contract Thursday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.headline: In battle for No. 2 role
items.description: Richardson is in a competition for the backup quarterback role in Indianapolis ahead of the 2026 campaign, JJ Stankevitz of the Colts' official site reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.headline: Signing four-year extension
items.description: Olave is signing a four-year extension worth up to $132 million, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
